§7§oObtain the item(s) shown.§r

Throw 64 AE2 Singularities and 4 Nether Stars on the ground, then hold a Nether Star and right-click an ME Controller to spawn a Micro Singularity. It runs out over time. The Constrictor lets you pick it up. Items thrown in are turned into this mod's late-game parts. SK-Tweaks replaces many of this mod's recipes, so check HEI rather than any outside guide.
